title: Vietnam Laos Cambodia Tour Package from India
highlights: Experience a day cruise at Vietnam’s Ha Long Bay, amidst stunning limestone formations and emerald waters, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its natural beauty.
Marvel at the Wat Xieng Thong, one of the oldest and most important temples in Laos, built in 1560 by King Setthathirath, symbolising the country's rich Buddhist heritage.
Admire the River of a Thousand Lingas at Phnom Kulen, an ancient riverbed that features intricate carvings of Hindu symbols, showcasing Cambodia's rich cultural heritage.

Explore the wonders of Southeast Asia with one of our best Vietnam Laos Cambodia tour packages from India, offering immersive experiences that blend rich history, stunning landscapes, and vibrant cultures.
overview:
About the destinations:
Explore the beautiful destinations featured in our Vietnam Laos Cambodia tour packages from India.
Vietnam is a captivating country known for its rich history, stunning landscapes, and vibrant culture. From the bustling streets of Hanoi to the serene beauty of Halong Bay, Vietnam offers diverse experiences for travellers. The country's cuisine, famous for dishes like pho and banh mi, reflects its regional flavours and traditions.
Laos is a hidden gem in Southeast Asia, celebrated for its stunning natural beauty and laid-back atmosphere. With its lush mountains, scenic rivers, and charming towns, the country offers a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of modern life. Luang Prabang, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is renowned for its well-preserved architecture and vibrant Buddhist culture.
Cambodia is a land of rich history and breathtaking landscapes, with the iconic Angkor Wat temple complex as its crown jewel. This UNESCO World Heritage site is a testament to the country's ancient civilization and architectural prowess. Beyond Angkor Wat, Cambodia offers diverse experiences, from the bustling markets of Phnom Penh to the serene atmosphere of Siem Reap.

know_before_you_go: Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites and temples.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
Always have tissues and hand sanitizer with you as there is no guarantee that there will be toilet paper or water and soap when you use the restroom.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
The currency used in Malaysia is the Malaysian Ringgit (MYR). It is advisable to exchange currency at authorised outlets or use ATMs.
Please note that it is not possible to convert money to or from Kip outside of Laos. Be sure to exchange all your Kip before leaving the country.

Cambodia is a tropical country with some risk of malaria and other diseases. If you are planning to visit rural areas or stay for a long time, you may need to get some vaccinations before your trip. Some of the recommended vaccines are hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, cholera, yellow fever, Japanese encephalitis and rabies.
Cambodia is a predominantly Buddhist country that values modesty and respect in dress code. Shorts, tights, plunging necklines, miniskirts, and other revealing clothing are not permitted.
It is advisable that you bring insect repellent and remember to use it on a regular basis.
Please note that Cambodian society is relatively conservative, and public displays of affection are considered disrespectful.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that all flight timings are as per Indian Standard Time (IST) Zone.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival in Hanoi, you will be transferred to the hotel. Check in and spend the day at leisure, soaking in the city's lively atmosphere. Explore the historic 87 May Street. Visit iconic landmarks like St. Joseph’s Cathedral and the Hanoi Botanical Garden. You can also visit the Statue of Lenin, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh | Cycle Tour to Bich Dong
days.desc: Embark on an exciting day trip to Ninh Binh, often called "Halong Bay on land." Take a scenic boat ride through picturesque caves and lush rice paddies. Enjoy a cycle tour to Bich Dong, exploring its ancient temples and serene landscapes. Immerse yourself in the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the area, capturing stunning photos along the way. After the tour ends, you will be transferred back to your hotel in Hanoi for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Day Cruise
days.desc: Today, set sail on a day cruise through the breathtaking Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Marvel at the emerald waters and towering limestone karsts that create a stunning backdrop. As you explore the bay, take in the stunning views and enjoy the tranquillity of this natural wonder. This day is a highlight of your journey, showcasing Vietnam’s awe-inspiring beauty. After the experience, get transferred back to the hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Luang Prabang | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out and board your transfer to the airport for a flight (tickets not included) to Luang Prabang in Laos. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check in. You can spend the rest of the day at leisure, immersing yourself in the serene atmosphere of this UNESCO World Heritage city. Stroll through the charming streets lined with traditional Lao architecture, and explore local markets filled with handicrafts and delicacies. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Luang Prabang Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: On this day, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour of Luang Prabang. Visit the Royal Palace Museum to learn about the city's history, then explore the breathtaking Pak Ou Caves, filled with thousands of Buddha statues. Discover local life at the Ban Xang Hai village market and visit Wat Xieng Thong and Wat Siphouthabaht, both showcasing stunning architecture. Also, hike up Phousi Hill for panoramic views of the city. After the tour ends, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Elephant Village and Mahout Experience Day Tour
days.desc: Spend a day at Elephant Village, where you will learn about elephant conservation efforts. Participate in a Mahout experience, gaining hands-on knowledge about caring for these magnificent creatures. You can also ride and bathe (extra cost) the elephants in the river, creating unforgettable memories. After the beautiful experience, you will get transferred back to the hotel in Luang Prabang for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Tonle Sap Lake Boat Ride
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to the airport for your flight (tickets not included) to Siem Reap in Cambodia. Upon reaching, you will be transferred to the hotel for check in. In the evening, embark on a scenic boat trip on Tonle Sap Lake. Witness the unique floating villages and observe local life along the shores as the sun sets, creating a picturesque backdrop. After the ride, board your transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Angkor Wat
days.desc: Today, enjoy a day trip to Angkor Wat and explore the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat temple complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site and a symbol of Cambodia. Marvel at the intricate carvings and grand architecture as you explore the ancient ruins. Visit other nearby temples, such as Bayon, known for its tree-covered ruins and smiling stone faces. After this immersive experience, you will be transferred back to the hotel in Siem Reap for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phnom Kulen
days.desc: Take a day trip to Phnom Kulen, a sacred site known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. Relax at the stunning waterfalls, where you can also take a refreshing swim. Explore the River of a Thousand Lingas, featuring ancient carvings, and visit the large reclining Buddha. This day combines adventure and spirituality, allowing you to connect with Cambodia's history while enjoying breathtaking scenery. Afterwards, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: This day marks the end of your trip. After checking out, you will be transferred to the airport in Siem Reap. As you prepare for departure, reflect on the incredible experiences from your days spent in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia. We hope you take along the essence of these beautiful countries and the stories that await to be shared.
